name: Calzadilla (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Calzadilla (a lion, a cross of Alcántara and a tower).
history: Municipal flag of Calzadilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Calzadilla arms — lion, cross of Alcántara and tower
